definition: Flutter Frame slice duration is UI-thread frame work; over_90hz counts durations > 1/90 s. SceneDisplayLag is emitted by Flutter engine when raster_finish_time > frame_target_time; missed_vsync_p95/max use debug.vsync_transitions_missed. SceneDisplayLag event count is reported separately and is not treated as a one-to-one late-frame percentage.
window: Each run scoped to [Android gfxinfo Stats since, Stats since + measured stopwatch duration), timestamps in ns.
percentile: Flutter findPercentile convention: sorted index round((n-1)*0.95), p95; durations are Perfetto slice dur in ms.
trace_health: Each trace reports clock_sync_unrelatable_clock_domains=1 and drops TrackEvent packets with invalid negative timestamps: run1 248234, run2 269534, run3 234076. Counts may be incomplete.

aggregate.note: Aggregated UI-over-budget count and event-count ratio only; p95 is reported per run.
